title: Inhibiting HSCs Activation and Ameliorating Alcoholic Liver Fibrosis by Fucoidan Targeting the TLR4/NF-kappaB Pathway.
authors: Wang, Guifa; Zhang, Nan; Zhou, Yifan; Yan, Jiayi; Liu, Yuhan; Liu, Man; Xue, Meilan; Liang, Hui
one_liner_zh: 该文研究褐藻糖胶通过TLR4/NF-kappaB通路抑制肝星状细胞活化治疗酒精性肝纤维化，虽含分子对接但对象为蛋白-小分子，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: Alcoholic liver fibrosis (ALF) is a disease characterized by excessive deposition of liver fibrous tissue due to long-term heavy alcohol consumption. Fucoidan is a naturally occurring sulfated polysaccharide extracted from brown algae. In terms of liver protection, fucoidan has shown an important role in the treatment of alcoholic liver injury. However, its therapeutic effects on ALF and the underlying mechanisms have not been fully elucidated. The objective of this study is to investigate the mechanism of fucoidan in ALF through network pharmacology, and to validate these findings using molecular docking technology and in vivo experiments. Molecular docking results showed that fucoidan had a strong binding affinity with toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB), tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha), interleukin-1beta (IL-1beta), and interleukin-6 (IL-6), suggesting its potential to modulate the TLR4/NF-kappaB pathway. In animal studies, the expression levels of proteins involved in the TLR4/NF-kappaB signaling pathway were significantly decreased in mice treated with fucoidan. Fucoidan also inhibited the production of TNF-alpha, IL-1beta, and IL-6, while reducing the expression of alpha-SMA, Collagen-I, and Collagen-III. These findings indicate that fucoidan could significantly alleviate alcohol + CCl(4)-induced ALF in mice by inhibiting the activation of hepatic stellate cells (HSCs).
abstract_zh: 酒精性肝纤维化（ALF）是一种因长期大量饮酒导致肝脏纤维组织过度沉积为特征的疾病。岩藻多糖是一种从褐藻中提取的天然硫酸化多糖。在肝脏保护方面，岩藻多糖在治疗酒精性肝损伤中显示出重要作用。然而，其对ALF的治疗效果及潜在机制尚未完全阐明。本研究旨在通过网络药理学探讨岩藻多糖在ALF中的作用机制，并利用分子对接技术和体内实验验证这些发现。分子对接结果显示，岩藻多糖与toll样受体4（TLR4）、核因子-κB（NF-κB）、肿瘤坏死因子-α（TNF-α）、白细胞介素-1β（IL-1β）和白细胞介素-6（IL-6）具有强结合亲和力，表明其可能调节TLR4/NF-κB通路。在动物研究中，经岩藻多糖处理的小鼠中TLR4/NF-κB信号通路相关蛋白的表达水平显著降低。岩藻多糖还抑制了TNF-α、IL-1β和IL-6的产生，同时降低了α-SMA、Collagen-I和Collagen-III的表达。这些发现表明，岩藻多糖可通过抑制肝星状细胞（HSCs）的活化，显著缓解酒精+四氯化碳（CCl(4)）诱导的小鼠ALF。
